public_rationale: The universal denial is contradicted by documented AI contributions to stock gains. Reuters ties Palantir's rally and forecast-related jump to demand for AI services, while also identifying defense spending. Palantir's primary materials document actual AI software use. Oracle provides another contemporaneous example of shares rising on AI cloud expectations. Other business drivers can coexist with an AI contribution; they do not establish that AI contributed nothing.
limitations: Independent news reports supply the market attribution; company disclosures alone cannot establish it.
This does not establish fair valuation, lasting returns or eventual profitability.
Oracle's eligibility depends partly on the scope of the hardware exception; Palantir avoids that ambiguity.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Apart from RAM and GPU sellers, stocks said to be growing because of AI are actually growing for other reasons.

statement.excerpt: I want to be really, abundantly clear about what’s happening: every single stock you see “growing because of AI” outside of those selling RAM and GPUs is actually growing because of something else.

from_speaker: outside of those selling RAM and GPUs
actually growing because of something else
our_interpretation: The plain reading denies a material AI contribution to the stock gains of every eligible company; it does not merely say other businesses also contribute.
The assessment examines the ongoing 2025 rally through publication. The speaker supplies no exact return window.
A well-documented positive stock response to AI-specific commercial developments at one eligible company is a counterexample.

Palantir's software business is outside the stated hardware exception. Oracle's cloud services provide an additional example, subject to ambiguity about whether the exception includes rented GPU capacity.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that gains across the relevant non-RAM/GPU stocks were attributable to other factors, with no material contribution from AI developments or expectations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one eligible company's stock gains have a documented material connection to AI-specific business developments or expectations, supported by commercial evidence and contemporaneous market reporting.
